subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw adopt first-party Wear OS support from this branch, and if so should it land as one branch or be split into staged Android shared/proxy/watch-app pieces?
rationale: This adds a new first-party app, auth and network surfaces, release packaging, and security-sensitive persisted state; automation can identify blockers but cannot decide the product and release ownership boundary.

options.title: Adopt after blockers are fixed
options.body: Sponsor the feature, require a clean rebase plus security, gate, auth-state, and proof fixes, and then review it as first-party Android release work.

options.title: Split into staged PRs
options.body: Land shared gateway helpers, phone proxying, Wear app UI, and tile/notification work separately so each surface gets focused review and proof.

options.title: Pause or replace
options.body: Leave this PR open as source work but ask for a maintainer-owned replacement only if Wear OS becomes an active priority.

recommendation.title: Adopt after blockers are fixed
recommendation.body: Sponsor the feature, require a clean rebase plus security, gate, auth-state, and proof fixes, and then review it as first-party Android release work.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the live assignee and has already contributed a Wear gateway config fix on the PR branch.
